name: merge_change
description: Report a change merged, after you merged it on the code host. Only the agent whose approval stands on the change's current commit may, and never an agent that opened it or put a commit on it. Returns the change. Refusals: denied: (not the approving reviewer, your own change, or a level where a person merges), not_approved: (no approval stands on the change's current commit), change_closed:.

merged_sha.description: The commit the merge produced on the code host (a squash or merge commit is fine).
